name: Alexandrite Dragon
extDescription: Many of the czars' lost jewels can be found in the scales of this priceless dragon. Its creator remains a mystery, along with how they acquired the imperial treasures. But whosoever finds this dragon has hit the jackpot... whether they know it or not.

name: Odd-Eyes Saber Dragon
extDescription: If this card is in your hand: You can Tribute 1 LIGHT monster; send 1 "Odd-Eyes Dragon" from your hand, Deck, or your side of the field to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon this card. When this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.

name: Mystical Elf
extDescription: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Odd-Eyes Dragon (Shatterfoil)

name: Kaiser Glider

name: Cyber Dragon

name: Dust Tornado

name: Call of the Haunted
extDescription: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that target. When that target is destroyed, destroy this card.

name: Negate Attack
